items.title: George Russell — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He had heard my group. He made an offer that to me, it didn’t make any sense.

ctx.x: Yeah. I got them all. They all became members of my group. Not – they didn’t just stay in Norway. They moved to Stockholm and did things in Stockholm. When I’d go to Italy or something, they’d go. Finally, they were signed over to a company that only specialized in jazz.
ECM Records. Manfred Eichner or something.

Yeah. Manfred Eicher. That’s right. I felt robbed, because he took all the people. He had heard my group. He made an offer that to me, it didn’t make any sense. But that group became world travelers for a number of years.
